issue_title: Fold the duplicated login case-folding in membership resolution
issue_body: selfPairs and derivePairs each lower-case the forge login inline before building membership keys. Extract one helper so the two call sites cannot drift.

plan.summary: Extract a foldLogin helper in the membership resolver and use it from both call sites.

approach.description: Add foldLogin(login string) string in membership.go returning strings.ToLower(login), and call it from selfPairs and derivePairs in place of the inline strings.ToLower.
Add a membership test asserting selfPairs and derivePairs produce the same keys for a mixed-case login as before.

verification.test_strategy: The auth package tests, including the new mixed-case login test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Both membership key builders fold the login through one helper.
Membership keys for a mixed-case login are unchanged.

false_alarm_examples.note: membership.go: foldLogin could weaken account isolation if a forge treats logins case-sensitively.
